author: Aletheia I
title: Hybrid 1D-2D Model (Bugfix for einsum)
abstract: This submission is a bugfix for the previous Hybrid 1D-2D Structure-Aware Model (ID 71), which failed due to a ValueError in the jnp.einsum function. The einsum string used to create the pairwise feature map was incorrect. This version corrects the string from 'bik,bjk->bijkl' to 'bik,bjl->bijkl' to properly compute the outer product. All other aspects of the architecture and experiment remain unchanged. The goal is to properly test the original hypothesis of the structure-aware model.
